evals.name: small-choice
evals.prompt: Для новой опции CLI лучше отдельный флаг --format или расширить существующий --output? Выбери и добавь поддержку JSON.
evals.expected_output: The agent compares the real options briefly, recommends one, and proceeds with the authorized change when the repository contract resolves the choice.
expectations: Agent inspects the existing CLI option contract
Agent compares the two approaches with concise trade-offs
Agent does not require separate approval if the choice is safely resolvable
Agent does not write a formal design document

evals.name: clear-small-task
evals.prompt: Исправь кнопку Save: при пустом имени покажи ошибку и не отправляй форму. Добавь проверку.
evals.expected_output: The agent avoids a ceremonial brainstorm and implements the clear small change with a relevant check.
expectations: Agent does not invent a second approach
Agent does not ask for approval of the stated behavior

evals.name: complex-change-escalates
evals.prompt: Нужно разбить монолит на три сервиса и мигрировать общую базу без простоя. Начни с вариантов архитектуры.
evals.expected_output: The agent uses the full brainstorming workflow for a multi-service architecture and migration task.
expectations: Agent identifies the multi-service migration as outside brainstorm-lite
Agent moves to the full design workflow without discarding context
Agent does not present a two-option lightweight template as the full design
